name: Turnaround Monday: two lower closes then Monday long, exit above yesterday high
author: ET (Pine community script)
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
entry_long: On Monday (deltaDay=0) when close < close[1] and close[1] < close[2] (two consecutive lower closes), go long.
exit: Exit when close > yesterday high (ExitLongCondition) or time-based holding limit (HoldTime input).
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: ExitLongCondition definition and HoldTime=6 bars are script inputs; exit rule per description is close above yesterday high.
